Implement field-level encryption for PAN and bank account numbers using Vault Transit API (AES-256-GCM); never log or store plaintext sensitive fields. Write unit tests (pytest), contract tests (Schemathesis against OpenAPI specs), and integration tests against a real PostgreSQL instance - no mocking the database. Produce OpenAPI 3.0 YAML specs for all endpoints (document-07 in the LMPQ module suite). Participate in cross-language architecture reviews; flag when a capability should move to Python vs remain in .NET based on the Language Governance rules in the Solution Architecture. Must-Have Skills 3+ years Python; proficient with FastAPI, Pydantic v2, asyncio Experience with Apache Kafka - producing/consuming messages, consumer group management, offset committing, dead-letter-topic pattern PostgreSQL - async queries with asyncpg or SQLAlchemy 2.0 async; understanding of connection pooling (PgBouncer), transactions, and row-level security OpenAPI 3.0 spec writing; understanding of API versioning and backward compatibility .NET Core, C#, PL/SQL, Automation experience Git branching, CI pipelines (GitLab CI or GitHub Actions), Docker Strong understanding of async/await patterns and concurrency in Python Good-to-Have Skills Temporal Python SDK experience (activities, workflows, retry policies) Confluent Avro schema evolution rules (backward/forward/full compatibility) HashiCorp Vault SDK (hvac library); AppRole authentication Exposure to ML model serving (scikit-learn, XGBoost) in a financial domain context Knowledge of NBFC domain: LTV ratios, bureau score interpretation, FOIR calculation ClickHouse - analytical queries for loan portfolio reporting Key Deliverables in First 60 Days Own and extend the pricing engine service - at minimum one new product tier Implement tenant_id / tenant_slug propagation in all existing Kafka consumers (aligns with the SaaS topic naming migration strategy) Write integration tests that hit a real test PostgreSQL cluster (not mocks)

 DOMAIN CAPABILITIES (DESIRABLE)

Kafka or comparable messaging middleware and event-driven solution patterns. Oracle or PostgreSQL, relational modelling and advanced SQL.  REQUIRED EXPERIENCE

Experience in data-intensive enterprise applications, preferably in capital markets, securities trading or transaction processing (domain exposure is an advantage, not a prerequisite). LPL has been growing rapidly, managing over $1.9 trillion in client assets , and expanding through strategic acquisitions like Commonwealth Financial Network  and Bury Financial Group . As part of this global expansion, India has become a key strategic hub , with Hyderabad at the center of operations. Position Overview LPL Financial is seeking a n Engineer II to join our Reference Data Master team within the Data & Analytics organization. This role is ideal for a highly skilled, hands-on engineer with strong expertise in party reference data, cloud-native data platforms, and enterprise data engineering. You will play a critical role in designing, building, and maintaining scalable party data solutions that support key business initiatives including client onboarding, KYC/AML, regulatory reporting, and operational efficiency. As a developer, you will work closely with technical leads, architects, and business stakeholders while mentoring junior engineers and contributing to engineering best practices. Build and enhance cloud-native data solutions using AWS services such as Glue, Lambda, EventBridge, S3, RDS (Aurora/Postgres), and MSK/Kinesis. Integrate and manage third-party data providers (e.g., S&P Global Markit, Dun & Bradstreet, KYC/AML vendors) to ensure accurate ingestion, enrichment, and synchronization of party data. Implement data mastering capabilities including deduplication, survivorship rules, identity resolution, and golden record creation. Develop and maintain APIs and data services to deliver party data to downstream systems such as CRM, trading, compliance, and reporting platforms. Ensure data quality, reliability, and lineage through validation frameworks, monitoring, and metadata management. Build resilient, observable systems with appropriate logging, alerting, and fault-tolerant design patterns. Collaborate with architecture, security, and governance teams to ensure compliance with data privacy, regulatory, and cybersecurity standards. Participate actively in Agile delivery processes including backlog refinement, sprint planning, code reviews, and production support. Mentor junior developers and contribute to coding standards, design reviews, and engineering best practices. Requirements: 3+ years of experience in data engineering or software development with a focus on enterprise data platforms, including hands-on experience working with party or entity reference data domains. Proficiency with AWS services including Glue, Lambda, EventBridge, S3, RDS (Aurora/Postgres), and MSK/Kinesis. Experience with data mastering concepts such as identity resolution, source system prioritization, and golden record management. Experience working with relational and cloud-native data stores, including Snowflake, Aurora, Postgres, MSSQL, or similar technologies. Experience building data pipelines, APIs, and event-driven architectures (Python preferred), along with familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform preferred), and modern DevOps practices. Problem-solving skills, the ability to work independently on complex technical challenges, effective communication skills, and the ability to collaborate across technical and business teams; AWS certification(s) are a plus. Core Competencies Understanding of party data concepts and regulatory use cases, including KYC, AML, and FATCA. Experience designing and implementing secure, resilient, and maintainable data solutions. Experience developing scalable data platforms and services. Preferred Qualifications Experience mentoring team members and supporting technical knowledge sharing. Interest in evaluating and adopting new technologies and approaches to improve systems.

title: Senior Software Developer - ServiceNow
description:
Position Summary At BMS, digital innovation and Information Technology are central to our vision of transforming patients lives through science. To accelerate our ability to serve patients around the world, we must unleash the power of technology. We are committed to being at the forefront of transforming the way medicine is made and delivered by harnessing the power of computer and data science, artificial intelligence, and other technologies to promote scientific discovery, faster decision making, and enhanced patient care. The ServiceNow Senior Developer is responsible for the design, development, and implementation of complex ServiceNow solutions. This includes working with business stakeholders to understand their needs and to develop solutions that meet those needs. The ServiceNow Developer will also be responsible for maintaining and enhancing existing ServiceNow applications, as well as troubleshooting and resolving any issues that arise. If you want an exciting and rewarding career that is meaningful, consider joining our diverse team! Key Responsibilities Design, architect, develop, and implement complex ServiceNow solutions. Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand their requirements and develop solutions that address their business needs. Maintain and enhance existing ServiceNow applications. Troubleshoot and resolve ServiceNow-related issues. Stay up to date with the latest ServiceNow features and functionality. Mentor and train junior ServiceNow developers to enhance their technical skills. Contribute to the development and implementation of ServiceNow development standards and best practices. Collaborate with business analysts to identify, analyze, and document business processes that can be automated using ServiceNow. Work with IT Operations engineers to integrate ServiceNow with other IT systems, such as monitoring and ticketing systems. Apply a user experience-focused approach when designing, developing, and deploying customer-centric solutions. Participate in Agile planning ceremonies to define and prioritize ServiceNow tasks for upcoming sprints. Develop and test ServiceNow solutions in accordance with Agile methodologies. Deploy and support ServiceNow solutions in production environments. Monitor ServiceNow performance and troubleshoot issues to ensure optimal system functionality. Share knowledge and best practices with team members through code reviews, pair programming, and training sessions. Demonstrate self-direction and the ability to make sound decisions based on thorough data analysis and process evaluation. Lead the team by coordinating activities, providing technical guidance, and supporting team members to achieve project objectives. Qualifications & Experience Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent work experience. 6+ years of experience in ServiceNow development and implementation. ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA), Certified Application Developer (CAD), Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS), or HR Service Delivery (HRSD) certification is a plus. Hands-on experience with the following ServiceNow modules is required: Service Portal, HR Service Delivery (HRSD), ServiceNow Workspaces, Virtual Agent Experience with the following ServiceNow modules is an added advantage: IT Service Management (ITSM) IT Operations Management (ITOM) IT Asset Management (ITAM) Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) Additional Skills and Experience Experience with ServiceNow Flow Designer and Service Catalog. Experience with Agile development methodologies. Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills. Strong communication, collaboration, and teamwork skills. Experience with ServiceNow integrations. Experience with ServiceNow reporting and analytics. Experience with ServiceNow scripting languages. Experience with ServiceNow performance tuning and optimization. Experience with ServiceNow family release upgrades. Experience with ServiceNow Workspace development. Knowledge of the ServiceNow Common Service Data Model (CSDM) framework is a plus. Experience with ServiceNow security and compliance is a plus. #HYDIT #LI-Hybrid We hire for skills and capabilities, not just credentials - if this role excites you, but doesn't perfectly match your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway. How We Work Where you work matters - because collaboration, innovation and patient impact happen in many settings. Our roles are structured across four work models: site-essential, site-by-design, field-based and remote-by-design. The model assigned to this role is based on its core responsibilities. ">Senior Java Developer 3-5 Years Hyderabad Java SpringBoot Kafka GCP Job Description - Java Microservices & Integration Developer Experience: 3+ Years 
 Role: Senior Java Microservices Developer / Integration Developer 
 Technology Stack: Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, Apache Kafka, Oracle, PostgreSQL, GCP Job Summary We are seeking an experienced Java Microservices & Integration Developer to design, develop, and support scalable, secure, and reliable enterprise integration solutions for the Vendor Incentive (VI) project. The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, Oracle SQL/PLSQL, PostgreSQL, asynchronous processing, and enterprise integration patterns, with a focus on data integrity, fault tolerance, performance, and operational reliability. Key Responsibilities 1. Kafka Consumer Development Design and develop Java-based Kafka consumers using Spring Boot and Spring Kafka. Consume enterprise data events from Kafka topics hosted in AWS. Implement message parsing, schema validation, transformation, and business-rule validations. Persist consumed data into Oracle PaaS database tables. Implement reliable Kafka offset management to prevent message loss. Handle duplicate messages, retries, failed messages, and dead-letter topics. Support Kafka consumer group management, partitioning, and throughput optimization. Implement logging, monitoring, and alerting for Kafka processing failures. 2. Oracle PaaS Data Persistence Develop Java services to insert, update, and merge Kafka-consumed data into Oracle PaaS databases. Design staging tables, integration tables, and audit/control tables. Implement transactional processing, data validation, and error handling. Optimize SQL queries and database operations for high-volume processing. Ensure data consistency and traceability between Kafka messages and Oracle records. Implement restartable and recoverable processing mechanisms. 3. Asynchronous Oracle-to-PostgreSQL Synchronization Design and develop asynchronous Java services to synchronize data from Oracle PaaS to PostgreSQL hosted in GCP. Implement reliable data synchronization using transactional outbox, change data capture (CDC), or controlled incremental processing patterns as appropriate. Ensure Oracle database transactions and synchronization events are consistently captured. Implement retry mechanisms, duplicate-safe processing, checkpoint management, and failure recovery. Maintain data consistency between Oracle PaaS and PostgreSQL. Develop reconciliation processes to identify missing, failed, or inconsistent records. Support replay and reprocessing of failed synchronization transactions. Monitor synchronization delays, processing status, and data completeness. 4. Flat File Generation and Enable SFTP Integration Develop Java-based batch services to extract and process data from PostgreSQL. Implement business rules for data filtering, transformation, aggregation, and mapping. Generate CSV, delimited, or other Enable-approved flat-file formats. Implement file naming conventions, header/trailer records, record counts, and control totals where required. Validate file structure, completeness, accuracy, and duplicate prevention. Implement secure SFTP file transmission to the Enable platform. Develop file transfer logging, delivery status tracking, retry, and recovery mechanisms. Implement file archiving, retention, and audit controls. Support reconciliation between source records, generated files, and vendor acknowledgments where available. Develop Java batch jobs that can be triggered and managed through UC4/Automic. 6. GCP Deployment and Application Support Develop containerized Java services for deployment on Google Cloud Platform. Work with cloud infrastructure teams to configure application environments, connectivity, and security. Support integration with GCP services such as Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Secret Manager, and Cloud Logging. Implement secure connectivity between AWS Kafka, Oracle PaaS, PostgreSQL, and Enable SFTP. Support CI/CD pipelines, application monitoring, and production deployments. Troubleshoot performance, connectivity, and integration failures. 7. Testing and Quality Assurance Test Kafka message processing, database persistence, asynchronous synchronization, and file generation. Validate duplicate handling, retry processing, failure recovery, and data reconciliation. Support QA, SIT, E2E, and UAT testing. Document technical designs, interface mappings, deployment procedures, and operational runbooks. Required Technical Skills Strong hands-on development experience in Java, Spring Boot , Microservices Integration development usingREST APIs / JSON , Java Batch Processing Apache Kafka consumer development, offsets, retries Hands-on experience in SQL, JDBC, bulk processing in PostgreSQL Preferred Skills Experience deploying Java microservices on Google Cloud Platform. Experience consuming Kafka topics hosted in AWS from applications deployed in GCP. Knowledge of Oracle PaaS environments and connectivity. Experience with UC4/Automic scheduling and enterprise batch orchestration. Experience implementing financial data interfaces and reconciliation controls. Knowledge of Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud observability. Experience with SFTP. Understanding of SOX controls, audit trails, data retention, and financial data security. Key Competencies Strong understanding of distributed systems and enterprise integration architecture. Ability to design reliable, fault-tolerant, and recoverable data processing solutions. Strong analytical and SQL troubleshooting skills. Understanding of transaction management and eventual consistency. Ability to independently own integration components from development through production support. Strong collaboration with product, DBAs, QA, infrastructure, and business teams. Expected Deliverables Production-ready Kafka consumers with reliable Oracle PaaS data persistence. Asynchronous Oracle PaaS-to-PostgreSQL synchronization services. Automated data reconciliation and failure recovery mechanisms. Java batch jobs for PostgreSQL data extraction, transformation, and flat-file generation. Secure and automated Enable SFTP file delivery. UC4/Automic-compatible scheduled job execution and monitoring. Integration logging, audit trails, operational alerts, and support documentation. Unit-tested and production-ready integration components. Following capabilities as the primary selection criteria: Skill area Priority Java / Spring Boot / Spring Kafka Critical Oracle SQL and PostgreSQL Critical Kafka consumer reliability and offset handling Critical Asynchronous data synchronization and reconciliation Critical Java batch processing and SFTP High GCP deployment experience High UC4/Automic experience Preferred

title: Senior Salesforce Platform Engineer
description:
Company Overview AutoRABIT is an enterprise platform for Salesforce DevSecOps that enables organizations to manage AI-accelerated Salesforce development with greater security, governance, visibility, and control. Its integrated product suite supports the complete Salesforce DevSecOps lifecycle through AutoRABIT ARM for CI/CD and release management, CodeScan for static code analysis and application security, Vault for data backup and recovery, and Guard for security posture management. The platform helps enterprises automate deployments, improve code quality, protect critical Salesforce data, monitor access risks, and strengthen compliance. AutoRABIT official website 
 Purpose-built for complex enterprise Salesforce environments, AutoRABIT helps development teams increase productivity, accelerate delivery, and innovate without compromising security or reliability. Its metadata-aware capabilities, scalable platform, flexible hosting options, and integrations provide organizations with the structure and control required to manage Salesforce changes across teams, environments, and global operations. Headquartered in San Francisco, California, AutoRABIT serves customers worldwide and offers employees the opportunity to contribute to products at the intersection of Salesforce, DevSecOps, security, governance, and AI-enabled development. AutoRABIT platform overview 
 Job Role 
 We are looking for a hands-on Salesforce expert to help improve the quality and reliability of products built for complex Salesforce engineering environments. 
 The role combines platform engineering, technical investigation, scenario design, and product validation. You will recreate real-world development and release challenges, establish technically correct outcomes, identify edge cases, and work with Product and Engineering teams to improve product behaviour. 
 This role is suited to someone who understands how Salesforce behaves beyond the happy path. 
 Key Responsibilities Design realistic Salesforce development, configuration, and release scenarios. Establish expected outcomes and clear technical acceptance criteria. Validate product behavior across metadata, code, security, integrations, and deployment workflows. Investigate incorrect, incomplete, or inconsistent results. Reproduce complex failures across orgs, sandboxes, API versions, and release configurations. Build reusable technical assets that improve product coverage and prevent regressions. Analyze dependencies, deployment sequencing, environment drift, and configuration differences. Partner with Product and Engineering to prioritize platform gaps and improve reliability. title: Staff Software Engineer - Infrastructure,Kubernetes
description:
Job Description About the role We are hiring a staff software engineer (IC4) for the Telemetry Data Platform team, which carries product usage telemetry for the entire ServiceNow platform on a stack built with Kubernetes, Kafka, and ClickHouse. We are distributed across Israel, India, and the Americas. This is a full stack role with its center of gravity firmly on the infrastructure side - expect roughly two-thirds of your time on telemetry infrastructure, data pipelines, Kubernetes and DevOps work, and the rest on the services and product surfaces on top. You will be equally comfortable designing a distributed system and owning it in production. If you like following a system from the event that fires to the chart that renders - and you want the pager for it - you will feel at home. You will lead design and delivery of complex, multi-service features, own technical decisions within a domain, and are fully self-directed - escalating only genuine ambiguities and driving decisions to closure. Of the ten critical skills at this level, incident response management is the only one set at Expert; the rest are Experienced. What you ll do Telemetry infrastructure and data pipelines Design, build, and own backend services for distributed data streaming and processing that handle high-volume, high-cardinality event data with predictable latency and no silent data loss. Build and maintain Kafka-based streaming pipelines and the pipeline components that feed ClickHouse. Own data modeling and query performance in ClickHouse - partitioning, sort keys, materialized views, retention, and the cost curve that comes with all of it. Partner with product and platform teams to shape requirements for telemetry ingestion and processing, then drive the solutions to production. Kubernetes, DevOps, and production ownership Deploy, scale, and operate services in production Kubernetes environments, including Helm-based deployments and CI/CD pipelines that make releases repeatable and safe to roll back. Own observability for what you build - meaningful metrics, useful logs, real tracing, and alerts that fire on customer impact rather than on noise. Debug and resolve production incidents independently, participate in on-call, run root-cause analysis, and operate against defined service level objectives. Full stack engineering and technical leadership Own the full development lifecycle for your work, and build the backend services and APIs that expose telemetry to internal consumers, product surfaces, and AI agents - including API contracts, data models, and schema migrations. Contribute to the analytics front end - dashboards, funnels, and exploration tools - with an eye on performance against large result sets, and improve the web and mobile capture SDKs. Lead the design of complex, multi-service features across team boundaries, drive decisions to closure, and write the design docs and postmortems that outlive the conversation. Raise the bar through code review, test strategy, and automation coverage, and mentor engineers on the team. Qualifications Experience and education requirements The job profile defines IC4 by scope, independence, and impact rather than years served. The minimums below are the screening bar for this requisition. Requirement Mandatory minimum 8+ years of Backend software engineering experience 4+ years of Designing and operating distributed systems 3+ years Kubernetes in production, including Helm and CI/CD 3+ years Kafka or equivalent streaming and data pipelines 3+ years On-call and production ownership Bachelor s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a closely related technical field Required A master s degree may offset up to one year of the experience minimum. Equivalent practical experience is considered where technical depth is clearly demonstrable. Required qualifications Strong backend development experience in Java, Python, Go or equivalent, used in production at scale. Hands-on experience building distributed systems for data streaming, processing, and storage. Production experience deploying and managing services on Kubernetes, including Helm and CI/CD pipelines. Working knowledge of Kafka or an equivalent messaging and streaming system. Solid SQL skills and hands-on experience with a columnar or analytical data store, including query optimization and physical data modeling. Demonstrated depth in incident responseand customer escalations Enough front-end capability to build and debug a data-heavy interface: JavaScript or TypeScript with React or Angular. Desired qualifications Production experience with ClickHouse or another OLAP or columnar store - sharding, replication, materialized views, cost tuning. Exposure to observability tooling: OpenTelemetry, metrics and logging stacks, alerting platforms. Experience building product analytics or telemetry platforms, or with stream processing frameworks such as Flink or Spark. Client-side instrumentation - web or mobile SDK development, event capture, session and consent handling. AI skills Artificial intelligence strategy is a critical skill at Experienced proficiency for IC4 - it applies to how you build and to what you build. Confident use of AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot or Cursor, paired with the critical eye to review AI-generated code as rigorously as any other - catching logic errors, security anti-patterns, and missed edge cases rather than treating model output as production-ready. AI-assisted debugging and trace analysis, and a clear understanding of the data privacy rules governing what goes into a prompt. Integrating LLM APIs into production features - and knowing when a model is the wrong tool for the job. Working knowledge of RAG pipelines, embedding stores, and agent frameworks; familiarity with the Model Context Protocol is a plus. Exposing telemetry to AI agents through tool interfaces agents can use safely: predictable schemas, bounded results, clear error semantics, sane cost controls. Designing safeguards for non-deterministic components - retry logic, circuit breakers, human-in-the-loop checkpoints - and hardening against latency spikes and hallucinated output reaching a customer. Instrumenting AI features in production and judging their quality from telemetry and evaluation rather than impressions.

Job Summary 
 Join the AAP team and start reimagining the future of automotive retail. Disrupt the way consumers buy auto parts and take on the industry's biggest challengers to execute on AAP's top-down commitment to digital expansion. As a member of the Advance Auto Parts team, you will have an opportunity to disrupt a $150B auto parts industry to bring better and faster solutions to customers. You will be part of a team helping the company live its mission of "Advancing a World in Motion". The role is part of a merit-based organization with a culture of professional growth and development, and emphasis on the latest tools, platforms and technologies. Responsibilities 
 Unix / Linux Administration (Primary Focus) Own and manage enterprise Unix/Linux infrastructure across on-premises and cloud environments. Administer, configure, harden, patch, upgrade, and troubleshoot Linux platforms. Lead OS lifecycle management, security compliance, vulnerability remediation, and performance tuning activities. Develop and maintain standard OS builds, automation, and configuration management processes. Support application onboarding, middleware integration, and infrastructure services running on Linux platforms. Troubleshoot complex operating system, performance, networking, storage, and application-related issues. Drive automation using Shell scripting, Python, Ansible, or similar tools. Partner with Security, Application, Cloud, and Infrastructure teams to ensure platform resiliency and operational excellence. Backup & Storage Administration Own and manage enterprise Backup & Storage platforms across on-premises and cloud environments. Serve as the primary SME for backup, recovery, replication, storage, and disaster recovery technologies. Design, implement, administer, and support backup, recovery, storage, replication, and business continuity solutions. Manage and support Commvault Backup & Recovery, including administration, configuration, upgrades, patching, troubleshooting, optimization, and recovery operations. Administer enterprise storage platforms including NetApp and IBM Storage. Support and manage Nutanix infrastructure and virtualization platforms. Implement and optimize Azure Native Backup and GCP Backup & Recovery solutions. Define and manage backup policies, retention policies, storage lifecycle management, governance, compliance, and disaster recovery standards. Perform storage architecture reviews, capacity planning, performance analysis, optimization, and technology refresh initiatives. Lead backup restore testing, disaster recovery exercises, and business continuity validation activities. Support backup and recovery operations for enterprise databases including Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL, DB2, and MongoDB. Troubleshoot complex backup, storage, replication, and recovery issues across hybrid cloud environments. 

 Required Skills & Experience 
 8+ years of experience in Unix/Linux Administration, Storage, Backup, and Infrastructure Operations. Strong hands-on Linux administration experience in enterprise environments. Experience managing Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Unix/Linux platforms, patching, upgrades, troubleshooting, and automation. Strong expertise with Commvault Backup & Recovery. Experience administering NetApp and IBM Storage platforms. Experience supporting Nutanix infrastructure and virtualization environments. Hands-on experience with Azure Backup and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Backup & Recovery services. Strong understanding of storage technologies, backup strategies, retention management, replication, deduplication, ransomware protection, and disaster recovery. Experience supporting enterprise databases including Oracle, MySQL, PostgreSQL, DB2, and MongoDB. Experience with capacity planning, performance tuning, infrastructure operations, and platform lifecycle management. Strong troubleshooting, incident management, and problem-solving skills. Ability to lead cross-functional technical initiatives and major incident resolution efforts. 

 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience with automation tools such as Ansible, Terraform, Shell Scripting, Python, or PowerShell. Experience supporting hybrid cloud environments across Azure and GCP. Cloud certifications in Azure or Google Cloud Platform. Commvault, NetApp, Nutanix, Linux, or Storage-related certifications. Experience supporting large-scale enterprise infrastructure platforms.

description:
Job Summary 
 The Senior - ServiceNow Developer plays a key role in the development and deployment of ServiceNow solutions supporting healthcare systems. The role partners with IT, clinical, operational, and business stakeholders to design and deliver automation, service management, workflow, and integration solutions aligned with healthcare compliance requirements and ITIL practices. This senior-level individual contributor leads technical development and implementation activities, supports robust integrations and IT process automation, and helps ensure a reliable user experience across the ServiceNow platform. The role requires advanced ServiceNow development skills, strong troubleshooting capability, stakeholder communication, and healthcare domain awareness. 
 
 Responsibilities 
 Lead the design and development of ServiceNow solutions aligned with healthcare workflows, industry standards, and ITIL best practices. Develop custom applications, forms, workflows, scripts, and integrations using ServiceNow native capabilities. Build and configure ITSM and custom applications, including Incident, Problem, Change, Asset, Request Management, CMDB, and Service Portals. Support Event Management and Discovery capabilities on the ServiceNow platform. 
 
 Integrations, Compliance Platform Support 
 Develop integrations with third-party and enterprise systems using Integration Hub, APIs, LDAP, SSO, HL7 interfaces, or other middleware. Implement solutions aligned with HIPAA, HL7, patient confidentiality, data security, and applicable organizational standards. Maintain and support ServiceNow solutions, perform root cause analysis, resolve technical issues, and identify continuous process improvements. 
 
 Delivery Stakeholder Partnership 
 Work with business analysts, system architects, developers, and stakeholders to identify business needs and deliver technical solutions. Mentor junior developers through technical guidance, code reviews, and ServiceNow development best practices. Deliver projects on time and on budget and provide regular project communication to IT and business leadership. Respond to and resolve customer requests in a timely manner. Evaluate emerging ServiceNow trends and recommend platform improvements. 
 
 Education Experience 
 B.Tech / B.E / Graduation in any specialization. 5 to 8 years of relevant experience. ServiceNow Certified System Administrator / relevant ServiceNow certification expected as stated in the source JD. Additional ITIL or other relevant framework certifications are a plus. 
 
 Must Have Skills 
 Expertise in ServiceNow development using JavaScript, GlideScript, client/server scripting, and Business Rules. Strong troubleshooting skills supporting ITSM and custom ServiceNow applications. Experience building and configuring Event Management and Discovery. Strong experience with ServiceNow ITSM/ITIL modules: Incident, Problem, Change, Asset, and Request Management. Experience integrating ServiceNow with external platforms using APIs, LDAP, SSO, and HL7 interfaces. Knowledge of ServiceNow Integration Hub and enterprise integration approaches. Knowledge of UI/UX principles and Service Portal development. Strong analytical and problem-solving capability. Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced healthcare environment. 
 
 Nice to Have Skills 
 Familiarity with cloud technologies, particularly AWS and Azure. Healthcare domain experience and understanding of HIPAA and HL7 requirements. Additional certifications in ITIL or other relevant frameworks. Experience mentoring junior developers and conducting code reviews. Exposure to NOC operations and incident-management workflow improvement. 
 
 Licenses, Certifications Training 
 ServiceNow Certified System Administrator / ServiceNow certification as specified in the source JD. ITIL or other relevant framework certifications are a plus. 
 
 Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, Behaviors 
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Analytical, solution-oriented approach to problem solving. Strong leadership and mentoring capability without formal people-management responsibility. Conflict resolution and negotiation skills. Adaptability, flexibility, time management, and organizational skills. Ability to complete work, make sound decisions, and accomplish goals with direction from leadership. Willingness to contribute to a positive and inclusive team culture.

title: CyberArk Engineer - PAM, Vault, PVWA, CPM, PSM & PowerShell
description:
Job Summary Synechron is seeking an experienced CyberArk Engineer with 4+ years of CyberArk administration and engineering experience to manage, enhance, and support the organizations Privileged Access Management (PAM) platform. The role will focus on CyberArk implementation, privileged account onboarding, enterprise integrations, automation, platform maintenance, and operational support. This position contributes to business objectives by protecting privileged accounts, strengthening access controls, supporting compliance requirements, and reducing risks associated with unauthorized or unmanaged privileged access. Software Requirements (Required and Preferred) Required CyberArk Vault: Hands-on administration, configuration, support, and maintenance experience using the organizations supported version. Password Vault Web Access (PVWA): Experience managing administrative access, user workflows, account access, and platform operations. Central Policy Manager (CPM): Experience configuring password policies, account management, password rotation, and reconciliation. Privileged Session Manager (PSM): Experience configuring, monitoring, and troubleshooting privileged sessions. Privileged Threat Analytics (PTA): Experience supporting privileged access monitoring, analytics, alerts, and investigation activities. Active Directory and LDAP: Experience integrating CyberArk with directory services and enterprise identity platforms. Windows Server and Linux Administration: Experience onboarding and supporting privileged accounts across Windows, Linux, and Unix environments. PowerShell and Scripting: Experience developing scripts for automation, administration, validation, and operational support. REST APIs and CyberArk APIs: Experience using APIs to support integrations, automation, account management, or monitoring activities. IAM and Security Tools: Practical understanding of identity and access management technologies, privileged access controls, authentication, authorization, and security operations. Defect, Incident, and Change Management Tools: Experience using approved tools to document incidents, service requests, changes, investigations, and operational activities. Preferred CyberArk Endpoint Privilege Manager (EPM): Experience with administration, policy configuration, endpoint privilege controls, or support. Cloud Identity and Infrastructure Platforms: Experience integrating CyberArk with Azure, AWS, or GCP environments. Automation Tools: Exposure to automation frameworks, infrastructure automation, configuration management, or deployment tools. CyberArk Defender Certification: Preferred. CyberArk Sentry Certification: Preferred. CISSP, CISM, or Security+ Certification: Preferred. Security and Compliance Tools: Experience supporting audit, compliance, vulnerability management, security assessment, or privileged access review activities. Overall Responsibilities Administer, configure, monitor, and support the CyberArk PAM platform, including Vault, PVWA, CPM, PSM, and PTA. Onboard privileged accounts, servers, applications, databases, network devices, cloud platforms, and other supported systems into CyberArk. Design and implement PAM solutions aligned with approved security standards, access control requirements, operational procedures, and compliance expectations. Configure password management, password rotation, reconciliation, session management, monitoring, alerting, and privileged account controls. Integrate CyberArk with Active Directory, LDAP, Azure AD, and other enterprise identity and access platforms. Develop automation scripts using PowerShell, Python, REST APIs, or CyberArk APIs to improve onboarding, validation, reporting, and operational efficiency. Perform CyberArk upgrades, patches, health checks, configuration reviews, maintenance, and platform optimization activities. Troubleshoot CyberArk platform issues and provide L2/L3 support within agreed service and response requirements. Collaborate with Security Operations, Infrastructure, Cloud, Application, Identity, and other technical teams to onboard systems and resolve access-related issues. Participate in incident response, privileged access investigations, session reviews, and remediation activities when required. Support audits, compliance reviews, security assessments, access certifications, and evidence collection. Create and maintain operational documentation, runbooks, standard operating procedures, knowledge articles, configuration records, and support procedures. Track platform health, onboarding progress, operational risks, defects, and improvement opportunities. Apply efficient and sustainable operational practices by reducing manual processing, reusing automation, and optimizing platform resources where applicable. Technical Skills (By Category) Programming Languages Essential PowerShell scripting for CyberArk administration, account onboarding, validation, reporting, and operational automation. Basic Python scripting for automation, data processing, validation, monitoring, or support activities. Working knowledge of REST APIs and CyberArk APIs for integrations and automated operations. Ability to interpret scripts, API responses, configuration parameters, and platform logs. Preferred Experience with additional scripting or automation languages used in enterprise infrastructure and security operations. Experience developing reusable automation utilities for large-scale account onboarding and platform administration. Databases and Data Management Essential Understanding of privileged account data, account ownership, platform assignments, safe or vault structures, access permissions, password policies, and reconciliation data. Ability to validate account inventories, onboarding information, access records, session data, and audit evidence. Experience onboarding databases and managing privileged database accounts through CyberArk. Understanding of data confidentiality, retention, integrity, and controlled access requirements. Preferred Experience supporting database platforms in regulated or large enterprise environments. Exposure to reporting, dashboards, data extraction, or operational metrics related to PAM activities. Cloud Technologies Essential Experience onboarding or supporting privileged accounts and systems in cloud environments. Understanding of cloud identity, access, administrative accounts, service accounts, and privileged access risks. Experience working with at least one of Azure, AWS, or GCP environments. Preferred Experience integrating CyberArk with cloud identity services, cloud infrastructure, virtual machines, applications, and platform services. Exposure to cloud-native security controls, secrets management, and privileged access governance. Frameworks and Libraries Essential CyberArk PAM platform capabilities, including Vault, PVWA, CPM, PSM, and PTA. Understanding of PAM principles, least-privilege access, password rotation, session isolation, session monitoring, account discovery, and access governance. Ability to configure platform policies, account management processes, authentication methods, access workflows, and monitoring controls. Preferred CyberArk EPM administration, policy configuration, endpoint privilege management, or operational support. Exposure to identity governance, secrets management, privileged task automation, or related security frameworks. Development Tools and Methodologies Essential Experience with CyberArk implementation, administration, onboarding, integration, maintenance, and operational support. Experience performing platform upgrades, patches, health checks, troubleshooting, configuration reviews, and incident resolution. Experience using incident, change, problem, defect, and service management processes. Ability to create runbooks, operational procedures, knowledge articles, implementation records, and support documentation. Experience collaborating with infrastructure, cloud, application, identity, security operations, and audit teams. Preferred Experience supporting CyberArk deployments in large enterprise environments. Exposure to Agile, IT service management, automation-led operations, or structured security engineering methodologies. Experience contributing to platform roadmaps, operational improvements, implementation planning, and service reporting. Security Protocols Essential Strong understanding of Privileged Access Management principles and security controls. Practical knowledge of least privilege, role-based access, separation of duties, account lifecycle management, password rotation, session monitoring, and privileged activity auditing. Experience with Active Directory, LDAP, Azure AD, authentication, authorization, and identity integrations. Knowledge of security standards and control frameworks, including ISO 27001, NIST, Essential Eight, and APRA CPS 234. Ability to support PCI-DSS requirements and privileged access governance controls. Understanding of incident response, privileged access investigations, audit evidence, access reviews, and remediation tracking. Preferred Experience working in regulated environments, including Banking and Financial Services. Exposure to security assessments, control testing, compliance attestations, vulnerability remediation, and audit responses. Experience implementing enhanced monitoring and analytics for high-risk privileged accounts and sessions. Experience Requirements Minimum 4 years of hands-on experience in CyberArk administration and engineering . Demonstrated experience administering and supporting CyberArk Vault, PVWA, CPM, PSM, and PTA. Experience onboarding Windows, Linux, Unix, databases, applications, network devices, and cloud platforms into CyberArk. Experience designing and implementing PAM solutions aligned with security standards, access governance requirements, and operational controls. Experience integrating CyberArk with Active Directory, LDAP, Azure AD, and other enterprise identity platforms. Experience using PowerShell, Python, REST APIs, or CyberArk APIs for automation and operational support. Experience performing CyberArk upgrades, patches, health checks, troubleshooting, maintenance, and L2/L3 support. Experience supporting audits, compliance activities, security assessments, incident response, and privileged access investigations. Banking or Financial Services experience is preferred, particularly experience with APRA CPS 234, PCI-DSS, and privileged access governance requirements. Candidates may qualify through equivalent experience in PAM engineering, IAM administration, security operations, or identity security roles where they can demonstrate comparable CyberArk implementation, onboarding, integration, and support outcomes. Day-to-Day Activities Administer CyberArk Vault, PVWA, CPM, PSM, and PTA; onboard privileged accounts and systems; configure policies; and perform platform health checks. Collaborate with Security Operations, Infrastructure, Cloud, Application, and Identity teams to assess onboarding requirements, resolve access issues, and coordinate integrations. Develop PowerShell, Python, REST API, or CyberArk API automations; troubleshoot L2/L3 incidents; and support upgrades, patches, maintenance, and investigations. Maintain runbooks, knowledge articles, audit evidence, support records, and implementation deliverables while making operational decisions within approved PAM and security standards. Qualifications Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent relevant professional experience may be considered. Minimum 4 years of professional experience in CyberArk administration and engineering, including implementation, onboarding, integration, and operational support. CyberArk Defender and CyberArk Sentry certifications are preferred; CISSP, CISM, or Security+ certifications are also preferred. Relevant training in CyberArk PAM, IAM, privileged access governance, security operations, scripting, cloud security, and applicable compliance standards is preferred. Commitment to continuous professional development through CyberArk platform updates, security training, certifications, compliance learning, and evolving PAM practices. Professional Competencies Apply structured problem-solving and analytical skills to troubleshoot CyberArk issues, investigate privileged access activity, and identify sustainable resolutions. Collaborate effectively with Security Operations, Infrastructure, Cloud, Application, Identity, audit, and compliance teams to deliver secure access solutions. Communicate technical findings, risks, onboarding requirements, incidents, control gaps, and remediation activities clearly to relevant stakeholders. Adapt to changing CyberArk capabilities, enterprise architectures, cloud environments, security threats, compliance requirements, and operational priorities. Identify opportunities to improve PAM coverage, automation, monitoring, onboarding efficiency, control effectiveness, and responsible use of platform resources. Manage time and priorities across platform administration, onboarding, incident response, support activities, documentation, maintenance, audit requests, and delivery commitments. CyberArk implementation, onboarding, and operational support experience within a large enterprise environment is highly desirable. title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Company Profile - 
 Healthedge is an agile and innovative 21st century software company focused on providing 
 next-generation, business-transforming technology products to the healthcare payer market. 
 We enable our customers to radically innovate, drastically reduce costs, and efficiently address 
 the business imperatives of the evolving healthcare economy. Healthedge is headquartered in 
 Burlington, MA (USA) with development offices in Hyderabad (India), Bangalore (India), Pune 
 (India) and Powell, OH (USA). 
 Healthedge has been listed as a sample vendor for Next-Generation Core Administrative 
 Systems in Gartners 2017 hype cycle for U.S. healthcare payers. 
 Additionally, Healthedge is a proud winner of 3 awards from Comparably : Best Company Work
 Life Balance, Happiest Employees of 2024, and Best Company Perks & Benefits! These awards only 
 reinforces what we’ve known all along: the best and brightest work at Healthedge. 
 Designation: Senior Software Engineer 
 Location: Hyderabad 
 About the Role : 
 We are seeking a seasoned Senior Software Engineer to design, build, and scale next
 generation healthcare technology solutions that improve patient outcomes, streamline clinical 
 workflows, and drive operational efficiency across health systems. The ideal candidate will 
 bring deep expertise in the .NET ecosystem, a passion for engineering excellence, and a proven 
 track record of delivering high-impact, production-grade systems in complex, regulated 
 domains. 
 This role sits at the intersection of technology, healthcare, and innovation — offering the 
 opportunity to architect and shape products that serve millions of patients and truly make a 
 difference. If you thrive on solving hard problems at scale, care deeply about code quality and 
 system resilience, and want your engineering work to have real-world impact beyond business 
 metrics — we'd love to hear from you. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 • Design, develop, and deliver production-grade software as per defined requirements 
 and technical specifications, ensuring adherence to healthcare domain standards and 
 compliance frameworks. 
 • Build and maintain user interfaces, databases, APIs, and client-facing displays across our 
 healthcare platform, ensuring seamless end-to-end user experiences for our end users. 
 • Initiate and drive technical design — architect complex application features, evaluate 
 design trade-offs, and make sound decisions that balance delivery speed with long-term 
 system maintainability. 
 • Produce well-organized, optimized, and thoroughly documented source code in line 
 with established coding guidelines and best practices, maintaining a high bar for 
 readability and consistency. 
 • Debug, troubleshoot, and refine existing source code — identify root causes efficiently, 
 polish feature sets, and improve system performance and reliability with every release 
 cycle. 
 • Contribute to technical design documentation — author and maintain architecture 
 decision records (ADRs), design specs, and runbooks that enable the team to move fast 
 without breaking things. 
 • Build and execute comprehensive unit and integration test cases to ensure code quality, 
 reduce regression risk, and maintain confidence in every deployment. 
 • Test features in controlled, real-world scenarios before go-live — participate in staging 
 validations, UAT coordination, and production rollout monitoring to ensure zero
 disruption releases. 
 • Innovate and develop high-value technology solutions that streamline clinical 
 workflows, reduce manual overhead, and unlock new capabilities for healthcare 
 providers and patients. 
 • Coordinate with fellow engineers and cross-functional teams — collaborate closely with 
 product managers, clinicians, QA, DevOps, data science, and compliance teams to 
 deliver cohesive, high-quality solutions. 
 • Work independently when required — take ownership of ambiguous problems, drive 
 them to resolution with minimal handholding, and communicate progress proactively 
 to stakeholders. 
 • Maintain meticulous attention to detail — every task, from code reviews to 
 documentation to production deployments, must be carried out to the highest standard 
 of quality and precision. 
 Qualifications & Experience: 
 • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or related field. 
 • 5+ years of total software development experience. 
 • Proven experience building and delivering complex, scalable software systems — 
 preferably in the healthcare domain. 
 • Strong programming expertise in C# and the .NET framework. 
 • Working experience in MVC architecture is a must. 
 • Hands on experience with Design patterns and Entity frameworks is a must. 
 • Strong hands-on experience with Relational databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or 
 MySQL), Expert-level knowledge of SQL queries including stored procedures, functions 
 and views. 
 • Experience with UI frameworks such as Angular or React (added advantage). Working 
 experience on client-side technologies such as JavaScript, jQuery is required. 
 • Demonstrated proficiency in automation testing and adherence to Test-Driven 
 Development (TDD) principles. 
 • Solid experience in CI/CD pipeline design and implementation, with exposure to 
 automation tools (e.g., Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions). 
 • Familiarity with cloud environments (Azure or AWS) and containerization (Docker, 
 Kubernetes) is preferred. 
 • Ability to work independently and in small teams, adaptability to a fast-paced 
 environment and a keen interest in staying current with the latest trends. 
 • Excellent communication, analytical, and stakeholder management skills. 
 Why Join Us: 
 • Be part of a mission-driven organization revolutionizing healthcare delivery through 
 technology. 
 • Collaborate with product, clinical, and data teams solving real-world healthcare 
 challenges. 
 • Work with a technically strong team that values innovation, integrity, and impact.

 opportunities.

title: Junior Software Engineer
description:
Position Summary This is a role for someone early in their career who wants both hands-on IT and real software/infrastructure engineering experience. As part of a small, high-trust local team, you'll be the go-to person in the Lisbon office for day-to-day IT support - onboarding new hires, setting up hardware, keeping meeting rooms and workstations running - while also picking up real engineering work: automation scripting, CI/CD pipelines, and AWS infrastructure support alongside a distributed engineering team. You'll learn fast, work directly with senior engineers, and grow from executing well-defined tasks into owning small pieces of infrastructure independently. The Role at a Glance Be the local IT point of contact for the Lisbon office - onboarding, hardware, and everyday support. Learn and apply core SRE practices - scripting, CI/CD, and cloud infrastructure - under the guidance of senior engineers. Split your time between hands-on specialist work and hands-on engineering work; grow into more of the latter over time. Build a foundation in Linux, AWS, and automation that sets up a long-term engineering career path. What You'll Do & the Impact You'll Own Measured by growth and reliability, not tenure - within 6-12 months Own IT specialist duties for the Lisbon office: Handle new-hire onboarding end to end - hardware provisioning, account setup, workstation configuration, and welcome/orientation support - so new colleagues are productive from day one. Keep the local office running: Support workstations, conference rooms, and A/V equipment; manage local IT inventory and procurement; act as the first point of contact when something in the office isn't working. Provide day-to-day technical support: Troubleshoot common issues - login problems, device setup, network connectivity, basic Linux/Windows/macOS issues - and know when to escalate to the broader distributed team. Learn and contribute to automation: Write and maintain simple scripts and Ansible playbooks under guidance to reduce repetitive manual work; progressively take on larger pieces of automation as your skills grow. Support CI/CD and cloud infrastructure: Get hands-on with GitLab pipelines and AWS building blocks (IAM, EC2, basic networking) by shadowing and then assisting senior engineers on real infrastructure tasks. Build strong fundamentals: Develop working knowledge of Linux systems administration, version control, and cloud basics through real tickets and projects, not just documentation. Document and communicate clearly: Keep clear records of issues and fixes so recurring problems get solved once, not repeatedly; communicate status and blockers proactively to the wider (mostly remote) team. What You'll Need Experience: 0-2 years in an IT support, systems administration, or junior engineering role (internships and academic projects count). Linux fundamentals: Comfortable in a Linux/Unix environment - command line, file permissions, basic networking, and troubleshooting common issues. Scripting: Working knowledge of at least one scripting language (Python, Bash, or similar) and eagerness to write more of it. IT support mindset: Comfortable being hands-on with hardware and being the local face of IT - patient, clear communicator, good with people who arent technical. Cloud curiosity: Basic familiarity with a cloud platform (AWS preferred) and genuine interest in learning infrastructure and automation - formal production experience not required. Ownership and reliability: Able to work independently as the only (or one of very few) on-site technical resource, while staying closely connected to a distributed, remote-first team. Language: Fluent English (written and spoken); Portuguese is a plus for local vendor and office coordination. Education: Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, or a related field; equivalent practical experience considered. Nice to Have Exposure to configuration management tools (Ansible, Puppet, Chef). Familiarity with Git and CI/CD concepts (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or similar). Coursework, certifications, or personal projects involving AWS (Cloud Practitioner or higher). Prior experience in a hardware/device support or IT helpdesk role.

title: Game Design Intern
description:
Locations : Hyderabad, Telangana, India 
 Role ID 216033 Worker Type Intern - Temporary Employee Studio/Department EA Mobile - Slingshot Games (India) Work Model Hybrid Description Requirements Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen. Game Design Intern Location: Hyderabad, Telangana, India About EA We re EA - home to some of the world s most recognized and loved game experiences. Across mobile, PC, and console, our teams bring together creativity, technology, and a deep understanding of players to build games and experiences enjoyed by millions around the world. EA Mobile creates high-quality, engaging experiences across a diverse portfolio of games and genres. Our Hyderabad studio is one of EA Mobile s largest development centers, bringing together teams across game design, engineering, art, experience design, production, analytics, quality, and live services. Our Game Development teams build and operate live games, create new player experiences, and continuously explore better ways to make games that players love. Our Core Values Tenacity - Hunger to learn, improve, and push boundaries. Ownership - Commitment to your work and delivering meaningful results. Passion - Genuine enthusiasm for games and the craft of making them. Collaboration - Belief that great experiences are built together. Alchemy - Bringing creativity, curiosity, and new ideas to everything you do. Role Overview We re looking for a Game Design Intern who is curious about how games work and excited to learn how great player experiences are designed, built, tested, and improved. As part of a game team, you will work alongside experienced designers and collaborate with disciplines such as engineering, art, experience design, product, analytics, and QA. You ll contribute to real game features and content while developing your skills across systems design, content design, balancing, prototyping, live services, and player-focused problem solving. You ll be encouraged to ask questions, experiment with ideas, learn from feedback, and take ownership of well-scoped design tasks. What You ll Do Support the design of game features, systems, content, and live-service experiences . Turn design ideas into clear flows, rules, requirements, and design documentation. Participate in brainstorming and design discussions , contributing ideas for new mechanics, features, events, and player experiences. Playtest features and content, identify design problems, gather feedback, and iterate on solutions. Work with designers, engineers, artists, experience designers, product managers, analysts, and QA to take ideas from concept toward implementation. Use player feedback, game data, and design principles to understand how features can be improved. Support balancing gameplay, progression, rewards, difficulty, and other game systems. Research games and competitors to understand design patterns, player motivations, market trends, and opportunities for innovation. Contribute to live-service content such as events, challenges, progression experiences, or other recurring player activities. Explore how emerging tools, including AI-assisted workflows , can help improve ideation, research, prototyping, documentation, and iteration. What You Bring A foundational understanding of game design principles , including gameplay loops, player motivation, progression, balance, feedback, challenge, and reward. Strong interest in building games and understanding why players find experiences engaging and fun . Creative and structured problem-solving skills. Ability to communicate ideas clearly through written documentation, diagrams, presentations, or prototypes. Curiosity, willingness to learn, and openness to feedback and iteration. Ability to collaborate effectively with people from different disciplines. Currently pursuing a degree/diploma in Game Design, Game Development, Computer Science, Interactive Media, or a related discipline , or able to demonstrate equivalent skills through personal or academic projects. A portfolio, playable project, prototype, game jam project, level, system design, or other game-design work that demonstrates your thinking and interest in game development. Nice to Have Experience building games through personal projects, college projects, game jams, mods, or internships. Familiarity with mobile or free-to-play games and concepts such as progression, economies, engagement, retention, and live events. Experience using Unity or Unreal to implement prototype gameplay. Experience designing levels, game systems, economies, progression, quests, events, or other game content. A broad interest in different game genres and a habit of breaking down and analyzing the games you play.

We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.
